ola-ro.hero: Firma nu se întărește în lunile bune, ci în cele liniștite.
ola-ro.sub: Disciplina pe care nimeni nu o remarcă acum — facturile puse la locul lor, chitanțele strânse săptămânal — se vede în cifrele anului viitor.

ola-ro.hero: Un abonament lunar fix. Știi de la început cât plătești pe tot anul.
ola-ro.sub: Contabilitate, salarii și declarații, într-o sumă pe care o poți pune în buget. Fără facturi apărute din senin și fără ore taxate separat.

ola-ro.hero: Semnezi o scrisoare și mutarea o facem noi, de la un capăt la altul.
ola-ro.sub: Trimitem noi contabilului tău actual cererea prin care ne predă documentele — professional clearance letter. Nu trebuie să ai nicio discuție incomodă.

ola-ro.hero: Scrii pe WhatsApp și îți răspunde un om, în română.
ola-ro.sub: Nu un număr de tichet și nu un formular. Vorbești cu persoana care îți ține contabilitatea, iar prima discuție este gratuită și durează 30 de minute.

ola-ro.hero: Plătești oamenii înainte de Crăciun? La HMRC treci data din contract.
ola-ro.sub: Exemplul HMRC: bani plătiți pe 19 decembrie, data din contract 31 decembrie — în Full Payment Submission treci 31 decembrie. Plătești la data obișnuită? Nu schimbi nimic.

ola-ro.hero: Cadou pentru un client: cel mult 50 de lire, cu reclama firmei pe el.
ola-ro.sub: Dacă treci de 50 de lire la același client, nu scazi din profit nimic, nici primele 50. Mâncarea, băutura, tutunul și voucherele nu se scad niciodată.

ola-ro.hero: Donezi 100 de lire și plătești impozit de 40%? Ceri 25 de lire de la HMRC.
ola-ro.sub: Se cere pe declarația de Self Assessment. La rata de bază nu primești nimic în plus, iar donațiile dintr-un an nu pot depăși de 4 ori impozitul plătit în acel an.

ola-ro.setup: Mi-a adus chitanțele de pe un an într-o pungă.
ola-ro.punch: Sortate. După cum au intrat în pungă.
ola-ro.hook: Chitanța contează doar dacă se mai poate citi. Fă-i poză când o primești: cinci secunde acum, o seară câștigată în ianuarie.

ola-ro.setup: «O fac săptămâna viitoare.» Spusă în martie.
ola-ro.punch: A venit săptămâna aceea. Este 30 ianuarie.
ola-ro.hook: Self Assessment se depune până la 31 ianuarie. O oră acum, în noiembrie, valorează mai mult decât o noapte în ianuarie.

ola-ro.line: În timp ce amânăm, viața trece pe lângă noi.

ola-en.hero: Ring us and you reach the same small team, with your file open.
ola-en.sub: We are small enough that the person on the phone is usually the one who did the work. Your business is on the screen, and what we agreed last time is in front of them.

ola-en.hero: Bring the question you keep putting off.
ola-en.sub: The first consultation is free and lasts 30 minutes. Plain answers to the things you have been meaning to ask, and nothing to sign at the end of it.

ola-en.hero: We watch the dates so they stop living in your head.
ola-en.sub: Your yearly accounts, your VAT, your payroll, your tax return. We aim to ask for what we need in good time, and to tell you once it has gone to HMRC.

ola-en.setup: "It's going out Friday." He first said that in August.
ola-en.hook: An invoice nobody chases is a donation. A date on it, a reminder, then a phone call, and your cash stops living on hope.

ola-en.line: Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.

bham.hero: Twenty minutes on a Friday, a folder, and a note of the takings.
bham.sub: That is the whole system. Invoices out while the job is fresh, receipts in one place, the week written down. Nobody claps. Then January comes and nothing in it surprises you.

bham.hero: There is a door on Washwood Heath Road you can simply walk into.
bham.sub: Bring the carrier bag of paperwork and put it on a desk in front of a person. We are at 22-42 Washwood Heath Road, Saltley, B8 1RB, and your first 30 minutes are free.

bham.hero: You will not spend the first meeting explaining your trade to us.
bham.sub: Payments with tax already taken off, van costs, cash takings, subcontractor records. We know how Birmingham trades run. The monthly fee is fixed, agreed up front.

bham.hero: Your year-end is already inside the monthly fee.
bham.sub: Nothing extra lands on you in January. We keep the accounts moving through the year and we watch the dates, so the end of the year is a phone call, not a scramble.

bham.hero: Up to £10,500 off the National Insurance you pay on your staff.
bham.sub: Employment Allowance, 2026/27. It does not arrive on its own: you claim it in payroll, again each April. Not where the director is the only one paid above the NI threshold.

bham.hero: 25% off the Council Tax bill if you are the only adult at home.
bham.sub: England and Wales. The single person discount. It stops once a second adult who counts moves in, whatever the household earns, and you apply to your own council yourself.

bham.hero: Five ways to work your VAT out from the day's takings.
bham.sub: The VAT retail schemes, for shops whose till cannot show the VAT on each sale. If yours can, HMRC expects the normal way. No form, no permission. Retail sales only.

bham.setup: He bought a 65-inch television at 60% off on Black Friday.
bham.hook: An expense is what the business needed, not what was cheap. If it ends up in your lounge, it is not in the accounts.

bham.setup: The van says one name. The invoice says another.
bham.punch: The bank will only accept the third.
bham.hook: One name on the van, the invoice and the bank account. Nobody can pay a business their banking app does not recognise.

bham.line: No great thing is created suddenly, any more than a bunch of grapes or a fig.

en.hero: The quietest week is the one where you already know the numbers.
en.sub: Hoping takes energy. Knowing takes a morning. What you earned, what is still owed to you, what goes out next: see those three and the month stops ambushing you.

en.hero: Someone sits down and tells you what your own figures mean.
en.sub: Not a document emailed at the year end that nobody opens. A conversation in plain English: where the money went, which month was the odd one, and what to do next.

en.hero: One accountant for the company and for your own tax return.
en.sub: Not two firms each assuming the other has it in hand. The same person sees what the company paid you and what you declare yourself, so the two agree before anything is filed.

en.hero: We set the bookkeeping up so you stop keeping paper at all.
en.sub: Receipts photographed the day you are handed them, the bank feeding itself in, the records looking after themselves. Nothing waiting to be sorted out later.

en.hero: 55p a mile for the first 10,000 business miles, from April 2026.
en.sub: After 10,000 miles it is 25p. The return due this January still uses 45p. Excluded: limited companies, and any vehicle you have ever claimed capital allowances on.

en.hero: The year directors were given to prove who they are ended 17 November.
en.sub: People who own or control the company must too. Free if you do it yourself through GOV.UK One Login; an outside provider may charge. You then give your code to each company.

en.hero: Owe your own company under £10,000 all year: nothing to report.
en.sub: Go over £10,000 at any point in the year and the tax is worked out on the whole loan, not only the part above. Loans taken in place of pay sit outside this rule.

en.setup: He says the whole Christmas party goes through the business.
en.punch: He has invited his cousin, his barber and a DJ.
en.hook: Only a party for your own staff can count, and only within limits. Your barber is a lovely man and he is not on the payroll.

en.setup: Three email addresses for the business, none of them read.
en.punch: So the brown envelope lives on the windowsill.
en.hook: Pick one address, read it weekly, and nothing official gets to sit there quietly getting older. We can be copied in as well.

en.line: The cost of a thing is the amount of what I will call life which is required to be exchanged for it.
